Patricia
Asturias, Spain266 contributions

Delicious coffee
Oct 2025 • Couples
We went several times during our stay, it is very cool and very quiet. The terrace overlooks the river and you comfortably order from there with a QR. The coffee is delicious. Coconut coffee was the best I tried in Vietnam, the same with matcha latte, and pandam coffee was something totally different and delicious! I had never tried it before and loved it.
One day we saw something we didn't like at all. A tourist sat down and asked for food and drink, and then switched to the terrace of another establishment. Afterwards they took her food and drink but she was no longer there, and the workers were left not quite sure what to do. Never be like that tourist 😭, you are mocking the work of others and you are wasting food.
A couple of coffees this special and delicious between 3-4€.
The place is super recommended.
